title: Telling what happened
goal: Tell about a past event and ask for news.

model.note: 了 at the end of the sentence shows the action is completed, carried through. It is not a past-tense marker: 昨天 is what sets the time. In the negative, use 没 without 了: 昨天我没工作.
了 right after the verb (去了) marks that this particular action is completed.

model.note: Set phrases to learn as they are. 还好 = 'not bad, okay'; 怎么样 = 'how is it going?'.
Reactions to learn as they are. In 太好了 / 太可惜了, 了 belongs to the exclamation pattern 太…了 ('so…!'): nothing to do with a completed action.

model.study: 昨天我们先{s}，然后去了公园。
model.phon: dzwoh-tyen woh-mun shyen {s}, rahn-hoh chyu luh goong-ywen.
model.native: Yesterday we first {s}, then went to the park.
model.reading: zuótiān wǒmen xiān {s}, ránhòu qù le gōngyuán.
model.note: 先… 然后… links two actions in order; 了 is not required on every verb of a sequence, it marks completion where you want to stress it.

model.note: 后来 = 'afterwards, later on' in a story. Final 了: completed action (回家了 = I did get home).

model.note: 做了什么: 了 after the verb (completed action), 什么 in the object's place.

model.note: Here 了 marks a change of state: the situation is new (I'm tired now, I finally get it). Same word, but a different use from the completed-action 了 of 我去了.

model.note: A past action is negated with 没 (or 没有), never with 不, and without 了.

readiness: You can tell what you did using time markers (昨天, 上个星期, 两天前) and 了 (completed action after the verb or at the end of the sentence, change of state), negate in the past with 没, sequence with 先… 然后… 后来…, ask how someone is and react (太好了, 真的吗, 太可惜了).
